note: Renders: scratchpad/w18 (m01-m19) and w18q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built from 05d4cc2. I diffed every frame pixel by pixel against scratchpad/w17 and w17q (script raterB18/diff.py, magenta maps raterB18/d_*.png). The monument changes are confined to where the commit says they are: m04 (mean |diff| 2.5), m05 (2.6), m06, q11, m03, m16, m09, m01, m12 and q19. q01 and m17 are identical, and m02, m07, m08, m10 and m15 change by 0.05 % of pixels or less. The m11 change (7.1 % of pixels) is the econ armrest commit 6ff75a6, not monuments. I found no regression of earlier fixes. The round answers most of the w17 list. The new monoAsh layer brings back a visible fine grain on the ash wall (m04 std 3.2 to 5.5) and the bar doors (q11 3.3 to 5.1) without the old coarse banding, though it is still about half the reference contrast (9.2 to 9.8). The bar nosing is now bright (m05 band #8d9097 to #d6d7da) and wraps both counter ends. The tumblers are dark glass at #3c3f43, level with the samchui render's #383539. The ash-wall openings now have rounded inner corners, the highlights are symmetric, and the clips are darker (#b23327 to #8e2c24 at p10). The welcome head no longer rises through the recess ceiling. The weak points that remain are small. The welcome pane now has no glass cue at all, so the cabinet reads as open shelving. The nosing is a flat, uniform white (std 5.5) that looks more like a white plastic edge band than satin aluminium. Each tumbler has two symmetric vertical glints that read like painted stripes. The ash-wall highlight strips still stop short of the corner arcs. The door-1 wood is unchanged. Lighting is noted but not scored: the q19 rear-galley ceiling still whites out, and the galley top compartments still look foggy. Scripts: raterB18/s.py (mean / p10 / p90 by luminance, plus std) and pair.py (w17 over w18 crops). Close-ups: raterB18/p_m04.png, p_m04corner.png, p_m05t.png, p_m05n.png, p_q11c.png, p_q11s.png, p_m06c.png, p_m16.png, p_m09.png.

details.note: The bright nosing now wraps the counter ends. The dark tumblers match the render's tone, and the doors and cheeks have a visible fine grain without banding. The nosing is a flat white with no satin gradient or groove, and the twin vertical glints on each tumbler look slightly painted on.

The wires are gone and the head sits under the recess ceiling. The D-boss, tag and frame proportions match omaat_room_32. The pane has no glass cue now, so the contents read as open shelving rather than as being behind smoked glass.

The rounded inner and outer corners, symmetric lit strips, darker clips and visible ash grain make this clearly the lalf_133 wall. The highlight strips stop short of the corner arcs, and the grain is still about half the photo's contrast.

issues.detail: Welcome cabinet glass has no cue (m03, m16, m14)
issues.problem: With the glints removed, the pane is fully transparent and uniform. The shelves and boxes read as open shelving, not as contents behind a smoked glass door.
issues.evidence: m03 pane (490,180,685,430) is #312f30, with std 17.5 coming only from the contents. omaat_room_32 shows a darker smoked pane with a soft, broad lighter patch across its upper left and the contents muted behind it (raterB18/p_m16.png).
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley in 10_mono.js, add one quad covering the whole pane, edge to edge inside the bead, slightly in front of the contents. If the engine supports alpha, use {c:'#8a8886', r:0.05, m:0.5, a:0.15}. Otherwise use a dark tint that lowers the contents rather than a bright streak. Do not use narrow strips.

issues.detail: Bar nosing is flat white (m05, q11, m06)
issues.problem: The nosing is now bright, but it is a uniform white band with no metallic gradient, so it reads as a white plastic edge strip rather than satin aluminium.
issues.evidence: m05 (100,515,900,530) is #d6d7da with p10 to p90 #d1d3d6 to #dbdcdf and std 5.5. The samchui_render_11 band (100,376,900,395) has mean #bcb8b4, p90 #f1f1f3 and p10 #685b4b (std 57.9): two bright bands with a dark groove and a grey lower lip.
issues.fix: In buildBar in 10_mono.js, add a 4 mm dark groove quad ({c:'#4a4a4c', r:0.5}) along the middle of the 45 mm nosing face, and give MONMAT.nosing m about 0.5 with c '#d8d9db' so it picks up some environment gradient.

issues.problem: Each tumbler now has two parallel vertical white glints placed symmetrically. They read slightly as painted stripes on a dark cup.
issues.evidence: raterB18/p_m05t.png shows two equal bright vertical lines on every cup at the same positions. The samchui glasses show one irregular highlight plus bright rims and bases.
issues.fix: In buildBar in 10_mono.js, keep one glint (x -0.016) and make the second a fainter and shorter quad (c '#7d8186', height 0.02), or drop it.

issues.detail: Ash-wall highlight strips stop at the corner arcs (m04)
issues.problem: The lit strips are straight quads that end before the rounded corners, so each corner shows a short unlit arc between the top and side strips.
issues.evidence: In raterB18/p_m04corner.png the side strip starts about 8 px below the arc and the top strip starts after it. In lalf_133 the lit edge runs continuously round the corner.
issues.fix: In buildAshWall in 10_mono.js, add a quarter-ring highlight (a few segments of 6 mm quads on radius 0.08) at the two top corners, or shorten the strips symmetrically and accept the gap.

issues.detail: Ash grain contrast still below the references (m04, q11)
issues.problem: The monoAsh grain is visible and unbanded, but it is still about half the contrast of the photo and the render.
issues.evidence: m04 (150,250,370,500) has std 5.5 and the q11 doors have std 5.1. lalf_133 (80,620,230,820) has std 9.2 and samchui_render_11 (180,410,280,470) has std 9.8.
issues.fix: In 03_tex.js (shared file, one line), raise PHOTO_GAIN for layer 33 from 1.1 to about 1.5. Check that m06 does not band.

gapWorth03: A soft, frame-filling smoked-glass pane would take the welcome galley to about 8.7. A grooved satin nosing and a single glint per tumbler would take the bar to about 8.9. The door-1 wood (8.3) and the lav doors (8.0) are now the lowest details. Fixing the q01 wood and putting the lav doors on the same monoAsh layer as the bar would lift the area by about another 0.1 to 0.2, to about 8.8.
